configuration: Pinned HMMER hmmsearch with profile tutorial/globins4.hmm, database tutorial/globins45.fa, fixed seed 42; upstream options applied.
observable: Keyed target/domain rows, identities, coordinates, E-values, scores and biases from output.tbl/output.domtbl.
default_vs_upstream: Runs the upstream exercise testsuite/testsuite.sqc with its options and captures scientific output; comments/timing excluded.
variant: Variant perturbs the first active match-emission field in a copied text profile by 0.02 so printed scientific scores can move.
altbuild: none: one pinned Debian toolchain is sufficient for this option/regression exercise.

evidence.floor_how: Measured by self-validation when the alternative build is available; otherwise no independent floor is claimed.

warrant: Rows are keyed by target/query identity and domain number; physical numeric fields use a one-score-unit bound while identities and coordinates remain exact. A missing search stage, changed score, coordinate or threshold crosses the bound.
